summary: Close relatives are guaranteed a share of the estate that a will cannot remove, believed to be half of their intestate share. Georgia has no trust law and is not party to the Hague Trusts Convention. Foundations exist as non-commercial entities.
reserved_share: Children, spouse and parents have a compulsory share, believed to be 1/2 of the intestate share; Civil Code of Georgia, art. 1307 (to be confirmed).
foreign_law_note: The 1998 Law on Private International Law governs succession conflicts; whether a foreign national may choose their national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: No trust law. Foundations are non-entrepreneurial legal entities under the Civil Code.
open_questions: Conflict rule for succession and any choice of law.
Whether a foundation may serve family purposes.
